_ghi_chu: Mẫu kịch bản hàng tiệm (Hiệu giày Hải Nancy), ghép bằng code, 0 Gemini. Kiểu dựng theo video anh Kha chọn 30/10 (32837D). Sửa từ ngữ ở đây, không sửa trong code. {shoe} = mô tả giày ghép từ info.json.
shoe: {type} in {color}, upper made of {material}, outsole made of {sole}
setting: A quiet old-town street paved with weathered stone slabs on a soft misty morning, warm diffused light, colonial-style shopfronts softly blurred in the background.
outfit: Dark, elegant smart-casual outfit (dark slim trousers, dark long-sleeve shirt or light jacket) so the shoes stand out.

model.nam: Adult Vietnamese male model (Input Image 2), used for body shape and outfit only.
model.nu: Adult Vietnamese female model (Input Image 2), used for body shape and outfit only.

framing: The face is not the focus: frame from the waist or knees down in every shot except the single full-body shot.
shots: Low tracking close-up of both {shoe_short} stepping forward on the stone pavement.
Macro close-up of the toe and upper, showing the real {material} grain and stitching.
One step where the heel lifts and the foot turns enough to clearly reveal the {sole} outsole pattern.
One full-body walking shot of the model in the street.
camera: Smooth cinematic gimbal movement, shallow depth of field, gentle cuts between the shots, 10 seconds total, vertical 9:16.
audio: No voiceover, no speech, no lip-sync. Natural footsteps on stone and soft ambient street sound with light background music.
fidelity_rules: Shoes must match the product images exactly: same color, same material and texture, same shape of toe, upper and sole.
Do not add buckles, laces, logos, patterns, stitching or decorations that are not visible in the product images.
Both feet wear the identical pair of shoes in every shot.
No on-screen text, prices, shop names, logos or watermarks.
